value: Adventure/stealth game with huge variety of gts scenarios and Live2D animations.

You are participating in an experiment to transfer your consciousness to a tiny humanoid, when the lab is attacked by terrorists who want to acquire the technology. While avoiding normal sized people, make your way through different environments to return to the lab and help other tinies along the way.

Explore areas while avoiding giant girls, scavenge the remains of other tinies to collect items which grant you various stats that allow you to interact with the level environment. Run using stamina, but stamina does not regenerate automatically. When spotted by a girl, evade her foot for long enough to escape. When captured, press the shift-key at the right moment to mitigate the damage from an impact or attack by consuming stamina. Game-over occurs when your HP hits zero.
